title: Lasi dialect
description: Dialect of Sindhi spoken in Pakistan
extract: Lasi, or Lassi, also called Kohistani is a dialect of the Sindhi language spoken on the western frontier of Sindh and Balochistan in Pakistan. It is spoken by the Sindhi Lasi people of Lasbela, Hub and Gwadar in Balochistan, and Lasi is also spoken in the Kohistan region of Karachi, Thatta and Jamshoro districts of Sindh.
